name: 60422 · Flossmoor, IL
findings: ZIP 60422 (Flossmoor) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60422 (Flossmoor) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60422 (Flossmoor) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
